    About THORChain

    THORChain is a cross-chain liquidity network that lets users swap native assets such as BTC and ETH without wrapping them. RUNE is paired in every pool and bonded by node operators.

    Where this RUNE price comes from

    The price above updates live in your browser from Binance (RUNE/USDT) and Kraken (RUNE/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade.
